title: Bites: AI-Powered Studying!

title: StudyTube : No distractions
description:
StudyTube – Study Planner & Focus

StudyTube is a study app designed to help you learn, plan your study schedule, and stay focused. Find educational videos, organize your study materials, create a study plan, set reminders, and block distracting apps — all in one place.

📚 LEARN WITH FOCUS

Search for educational videos on the topics you want to study. Find content for mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, programming, coding, computer science, DSA, English, exam preparation, and more.

StudyTube gives you a focused learning experience so you can spend more time studying and less time getting distracted.

🎥 SAVE VIDEOS & CREATE STUDY PLAYLISTS

Save useful educational videos and watch them later.

Create personalized study playlists to organize videos by subject, chapter, exam, or topic. StudyTube also remembers your video progress, so you can continue learning from where you stopped.

📅 STUDY PLANNER

Create your own study schedule with the Study Planner.

Plan what you want to study for the next 24 hours, week, or month. Add study tasks, videos, and playlists to your plan and keep track of what you want to learn.

Whether you are preparing for exams, studying for college, revising school subjects, or learning a new skill, StudyTube helps you organize your time.

⏰ STUDY REMINDERS & ALARMS

Set study reminders and alarms for your planned study sessions.

Build a regular study routine and get reminded when it is time to study. Plan your day, stay on schedule, and make consistent progress toward your goals.

🚫 FOCUS MODE & APP BLOCKER

Distractions can make it difficult to concentrate.

Use StudyTube Focus Mode to block distracting apps such as Instagram, games, and other apps while you study. Start your study session, reduce distractions, and keep your attention on your work.

🎯 EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO STUDY BETTER

StudyTube combines learning and productivity tools in one app:

✅ Educational video search
✅ Study planner
✅ Daily, weekly and monthly study schedules
✅ Study reminders and alarms
✅ Focus Mode
✅ App blocker
✅ Video bookmarks
✅ Personalized study playlists
✅ Video progress tracking
✅ Exam preparation support

StudyTube is built for students who want to study smarter, organize their time, and stay focused.

Plan your studies. Learn from educational content. Block distractions. Build better study habits.

Download StudyTube and make every study session count. 🚀

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE API DISCLOSURE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
StudyTube includes an optional "Focus Mode / Distraction Blocker" feature designed to help students study without interruptions. 

To enable website blocking during active study sessions, StudyTube uses Android's AccessibilityService API.

• Purpose: To detect when you navigate to user-defined distracting websites in supported web browsers (e.g., Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Brave, Samsung Internet) while a Focus session is actively running, and immediately redirect you back to StudyTube or display a focus reminder screen.
• Data Privacy: StudyTube DOES NOT collect, store, transmit, or share any personal or sensitive user information, login credentials, passwords, keystrokes, or browsing history. All URL inspection and keyword matching is performed 100% locally and offline on your device, and only during active Focus sessions.
• User Control: The Accessibility Service is completely optional and disabled by default. It is only activated if you explicitly grant permission after viewing our prominent in-app disclosure, and you can disable it at any time in your device's Android Settings.
